# Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions

Downloads and tidies the monthly HMRC Tax Receipts and National
Insurance Contributions bulletin published on GOV.UK. The bulletin
covers all major UK taxes and duties from April 2016 to the most recent
month (monthly granularity), updated on approximately the 15th working
day of each month.

## Usage

``` r
get_tax_receipts(tax = NULL, start = NULL, end = NULL, cache = TRUE)
```

## Source

<https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/hmrc-tax-and-nics-receipts-for-the-uk>

## Arguments

- tax:

  Character vector of tax head identifiers, or `NULL` (default) to
  return all available series. Use
  [`list_tax_heads()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/list_tax_heads.md)
  to see valid values and descriptions.

- start:

  Character `"YYYY-MM"` or a `Date` object. If provided, rows before
  this month are dropped.

- end:

  Character `"YYYY-MM"` or a `Date` object. If provided, rows after this
  month are dropped.

- cache:

  Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the downloaded file is cached locally
  and reused on subsequent calls. Use
  [`clear_cache()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/clear_cache.md)
  to reset.

## Value

A data frame with columns:

- date:

  `Date`. The first day of the reference month.

- tax_head:

  Character. Tax or duty identifier (see
  [`list_tax_heads()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/list_tax_heads.md)).

- description:

  Character. Plain-English series label.

- receipts_gbp_m:

  Numeric. Cash receipts in millions of pounds (GBP).

## See also

Other tax receipts:
[`get_income_tax_stats()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_income_tax_stats.md),
[`get_vat()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_vat.md)

## Examples

``` r
# \donttest{
op <- options(hmrc.cache_dir = tempdir())
# All tax heads
get_tax_receipts()
```
